name: Get import notification
description: Call this when you need to check the current status of a contacts import job and retrieve any process data that may be attached. Use a dedicated import‑details action if you need to fetch the full import results or modify the import.

time.description: Timestamp (HH:MM:SS) when the notification was generated.

status.description: Overall status of the import job.

allProcessData.description: Array containing detailed process data for the import, may be empty.
